doc_title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Stock
doc_title_jp: 自己株式の消却に関するお知らせ
summary_en: 11,556 common shares (0.33% of shares outstanding) to be cancelled effective 2026-10-13. Represents all treasury stock held as of 2026-07-21. Post-cancellation issued share count: 3,498,444. Cancellation is conditional on shareholder approval of a stock consolidation (effective 2026-10-14) at the extraordinary general meeting scheduled 2026-09-16.
summary_jp: 普通株式11,556株（0.33%）を2026年10月13日に消却。2026年7月21日時点の自己株式全部に相当。消却後発行済株式数3,498,444株。2026年10月14日発効の株式併合の株主総会承認を条件。

doc_title_en: Notice regarding completion of tender offer for shares of Ryomo Systems by controlling shareholders Mitsuba Corp. and Chubu Electric Power Co., and changes in major shareholders
doc_title_jp: 支配株主である株式会社ミツバ及び中部電力株式会社による当社株式に対する公開買付けの結果並びに主要株主の異動に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 支配株主による完全子会社化

summary_en: Tender offer by Mitsuba Corp. (controlling shareholder) and Chubu Electric Power Co. closed 8 July 2026 after running 15 May–8 July. Tender acceptance: 1,599,686 shares (45.6% of shares ex-treasury, 3,498,487 denominator). Minimum threshold 537,260 shares exceeded; offer successful. Mitsuba to acquire first 1,003,800 shares; Chubu Electric to acquire remainder (595,886 shares, 17.03% post-settlement voting stake). Settlement begins 15 July 2026. Chubu Electric becomes major shareholder (second-largest by voting rights). Further squeeze-out procedures planned to achieve 100% ownership.
summary_jp: ミツバ（支配株主）・中部電力による公開買付、2026年7月8日終了（5月15日開始）。応募1,599,686株（自己株式除外で45.6%）。下限537,260株超過、成立。ミツバが1,003,800株、中部電力が595,886株（議決権17.03%）を取得。決済7月15日開始。中部電力が主要株主に。完全子会社化に向け追加手続予定。

tag_jp: MBO完了 – 1,599,686株応募（自己株式除外で45.6%）– ミツバ・中部電力 – 上場廃止予定

doc_title_en: Notice of Expression of Support for Tender Offer for Company Shares by Controlling Shareholder Mitsuba Co., Ltd. and Chubu Electric Power Co., Inc., Recommendation to Participate, and Notice of Execution of Capital and Business Partnership Agreement with Chubu Electric Power Co., Inc.

key_facts.reason_jp: 親会社ミツバ及び中部電力による経営統合・完全子会社化

summary_en: Mitsuba Co. (51.31% holder) and Chubu Electric Co. to acquire all remaining RYOMO shares via tender offer at ¥2,700 per share (total ¥9,450M approx.). Post-close ownership: Mitsuba 80%, Chubu Electric 20%. Board recommends tendering. Share delisting expected. Strategic capital partnership agreement with Chubu Electric to be executed.
summary_jp: ミツバ（現在51.31%保有）と中部電力が全株式取得、1株当たり¥2,700で公開買付け。買付け後の議決権比率：ミツバ80%、中部電力20%。上場廃止予定。経営陣は応募推奨。中部電力との資本業務提携契約を締結予定。
